notes: Replaces earlier monochrome/sepia illustrations with new natural-color food photography. Existing images were inspected for context but were not passed as generation references. Original generated PNGs remain untouched. Final files were encoded to JPEG at quality 92 with mozjpeg, without visual post-processing.

images.alt: Chipped dried beef in creamy milk gravy over golden toast beside milk, flour, butter and a skillet
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: new editorial recipe website hero, landscape 1536x1024.
Create a completely NEW realistic natural-color food photograph of homemade chipped beef on toast, inspired by economical cottage-kitchen cooking. Foreground: two overlapping slices of golden-brown toasted white bread on one simple muted pale-blue ceramic dinner plate, generously topped with thick ivory-white milk-and-flour roux gravy containing many small thin irregular torn reddish-brown pieces of dried beef, their slightly frizzled edges visible, and fine black pepper. The gravy coats bread and pools slightly on the plate; toast crust remains visible. Delicate natural steam, appetizing but honest homemade texture. This is chipped dried beef, not ground beef or large steak strips.
Secondary props on honey-toned wooden table: an ordinary dark skillet holding a little more of the same gravy, a small milk pitcher, a small bowl of flour, and two small butter pats on a plain saucer. A simple stainless four-tine fork and plain table knife rest separately on a folded oatmeal linen napkin, with physically correct utensil geometry. Objects are few, logical, and separate.
Warm natural window light from left, soft neutral shadows, authentic full color, creamy white gravy, rosy-brown beef, golden toast, light blue plate; not vintage monochrome or sepia. A close three-quarter camera perspective with food dominant and props softly subordinate. Modest clean lived-in cottage kitchen, no luxury styling, no theatrical decoration.
Exact recipe basis: toasted bread, dried chipped beef, butter, flour, milk, salt and pepper. No parsley, green herbs, eggs, vegetables or garnish; no extra food. No people/hands, military props, branding, decorative text, watermark, scratches or old-film effect. New scene, not a recolor of an old image.
images.inspection: Small torn dried beef pieces, white roux gravy and golden toast match the recipe; fork, knife, pitcher and skillet geometry are coherent; no extra garnish or people.

images.alt: Egg noodles with browned ground beef and creamed corn beside buttered white bread and Campbell's Chicken Noodle Soup
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: new editorial recipe website hero, landscape 1536x1024.
Create a completely NEW highly believable natural-color photograph of an economical homemade beef-and-noodles dinner in a modest warm cottage kitchen. The finished dish fills a generous simple shallow off-white ceramic bowl in the foreground: tender wide wavy yellow egg noodles mixed throughout with small distinct browned GROUND BEEF crumbles and yellow creamed corn, lightly coated in a moist golden savory sauce made from condensed chicken noodle soup. Some small corn kernels visible in the cream-style corn mixture. The beef must be ground beef crumbles, never sliced steak. This is a thick spoonable one-pot dinner rather than a brothy soup, no heavy white cream or cheese sauce. Delicate natural steam, authentic home-cooked texture.
A small side plate holds two ordinary slices of soft white bread with visibly spread pale butter. Secondary ingredient props: ONE closed classic Campbell's Chicken Noodle Soup can with natural red upper label and white lower label, legible main wording "Campbell's", "CONDENSED", "Chicken Noodle Soup"; and a second small completely GENERIC store-brand-style cream corn can with simple green/yellow label reading only "CREAM STYLE CORN" and an illustration of corn. The corn can must have NO Campbell's logo or brand. No other labels, claims or promotional text. A small plain bowl of dry egg noodles may be behind the dish.
An ordinary dark cooking pot rests in the rear on a wooden trivet. One simple stainless serving spoon lies beside the foreground bowl, handle fully visible and physically correct, no fused or doubled utensils. Worn light wooden table, a muted blue checked tea towel, soft honey-colored natural window light, soft neutral shadows, food foreground dominating over ingredient cans and props. Genuine full color: yellow noodles and corn, browned beef, red Campbell's label, blue cloth. No monochrome, sepia, old-film grain or theatrical luxury styling.
Only actual recipe ingredients: ground beef, egg noodles, creamed corn, Campbell's condensed chicken noodle soup, water or light chicken stock, salt, pepper; buttered white bread alongside. No fresh herb garnish, parsley, broccoli, mushrooms, tomatoes, onion chunks, cheese, meat strips or unrelated decorative ingredients. No people/hands, text overlay or watermark. New image from scratch, not a recoloring of an old image.
images.inspection: Ground beef is visibly crumbled, not sliced. Egg noodles, creamed corn, buttered white bread and correctly named Campbell's Chicken Noodle Soup are present. Corn can is generic and does not carry Campbell's branding. Closed cans and simple spoon have coherent geometry.
